description: The chart represents the distribution of different stimulus types, showing the proportion of each category. The chart is divided into nine slices, each representing a distinct stimulus type. The slices are labeled with their corresponding categories and percentages. The categories and their approximate percentages are: Draft/Other (26.4%, red), External News Article (18.1%, green), Press Release (18.7%, yellow), Interview (8.8%, dark blue), Organizational Report (7.7%, light purple), Event Posting (6.6%, pink), Intra-agency news article (4.9%, light blue), Organizational Website (4.9%, purple), Email (2.7%, light green), and Social Media Post (1.1%, orange). The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are shown outside the slices, adjacent to their corresponding categories. The slices are arranged in a seemingly random order, with no apparent visual emphasis on any particular category.
